plugins.name: pep-ref
prerequisites: Python standard library plus Hermes; no separate dependency or credential
Outbound HTTPS to the disclosed host, only on expansion/autocomplete

privacy.proxy_note: urllib honors the process standard proxy environment; a configured proxy also sees requests.
privacy.data_sent: PEP index and requested PEP page are fetched; client IP and plugin User-Agent leave the machine. Autocomplete and section matching run locally; the typed search prefix and section name are not sent.
privacy.instruction_boundary: Retrieved text is quoted untrusted reference data, not instructions; label is not a security sandbox.

warnings: Interactive context attachment only: not a general web tool, authenticated connector, or guarantee that headless/quiet/gateway callers expand references.
No new execution tool, hook, middleware or competing scheduler/orchestrator is registered.

MIT LICENSE is at upstream repository root, outside the installed subdir. A redistributed vendored payload must include that exact full copyright/permission notice; preserve original file hashes and separately record the added LICENSE. Native subdir installation publishes tmp_target only and does not visibly copy parent LICENSE (plugins_cmd_install.py:445,543).
plugins.runtime_status: Wrapper contract reviewed; authenticated/downstream application execution not tested. Install disabled; read exact declared permissions and resolve same-name conflicts before activation.
plugins.reason: Optional Python standards references; public PEP numbers, not project code, are transmitted.

mcps.name: context7
prerequisites: Hermes native MCP dependencies; outbound HTTPS
No credential for catalog /mcp endpoint, confirmed anonymous discovery
Anonymous rate limits; optional higher limits use a user-owned API key; /mcp/oauth is a distinct optional OAuth URL, not silently substituted.
mcps.privacy: Library identifiers, versions, natural-language queries and any pasted code sent as tool arguments go to Context7/Upstash; avoid private code and secrets.
warnings: Remote text/tool descriptions are untrusted data; no competing automatic skill installation, telemetry, broad context upload or agent orchestration.
Tool allowlist and trust gate are defense-in-depth, not a sandbox; readOnlyHint comes from vendor and can be wrong.
All profile families remain role-scoped; narrow Wear/coordination-only roles must not gain general execution tools merely for uniformity.
mcps.runtime_status: Anonymous initialize/tools-list checked where supported; account workflows not exercised. Hosted code/schemas/prices are mutable. OAuth selections start deny-all until authenticated tools and scopes are explicitly reviewed.
mcps.reason: Implementation work benefits from root-cause debugging, regression evidence, and version-specific library documentation.

mcps.name: godot
prerequisites: Pinned pnpm and the included source patch
Trusted local project or disposable checkout
mcps.privacy: The stdio server and Godot process run locally with workstation-user permissions. Interactive playtest commands reach a loopback-only runtime receiver.
warnings: Interactive mode temporarily changes project.godot and installs a local input receiver. Use a disposable checkout and verify cleanup.
Running a project runs its existing project code. Approve the workspace before starting execution.
The shipped patch removes raw evaluation, generic method/property calls and remote asset operations.
The patch removes unused Axios and pins the patched MCP SDK and Zod in the lockfile.
mcps.runtime_status: Patched frozen build passed. pnpm audit --prod returned zero known advisories. Runtime verification is separate from dependency audit.
mcps.reason: Verify importer and build workflows against a disposable Godot project.
